name: L02 - Repricing cadence
text:
Most short-stay homes in India are priced once and then left alone for a season.

That single decision costs more than every other mistake combined.

A rate set in June does not know about the wedding weekend in October, the flight loads into Dabolim in December, or the villa two lanes away that dropped its price last Tuesday. It just sits there, either turning away money on the good nights or sitting empty on the ordinary ones.

What we actually do, every week, on every home:

- Look at what is left unsold in the next 90 days
- Check what comparable homes nearby have moved to
- Adjust minimum stays before adjusting price, because a two-night gap you cannot sell is a pricing problem disguised as a calendar problem
- Raise on the dates that are filling faster than usual, not just cut on the ones that are not

The cuts get all the attention. The raises are where the money is.

None of this is clever. It is just done weekly instead of seasonally, which turns out to be the entire difference.

name: L03 - You stay the host of record
text:
The question every second-home owner asks us, usually about eight minutes in:

"If this does not work out, what do I lose?"

Fair question. Plenty of management arrangements answer it badly. The listing sits on the company's account, the reviews accumulate under the company's name, and the day you leave you are starting from zero on a platform where zero reviews means zero bookings.

We do it the other way round. We join as a co-host on your listing. Your Airbnb account, your name as host, your reviews, your payout details. We get the access we need to do the work, and nothing more.

If you want to stop, you remove us as a co-host. The home keeps its rating, its review count and its search position. Nothing to migrate, nothing to rebuild.

It makes leaving easy on purpose, because an arrangement that has to trap you to keep you is not one worth signing.

Commission only. No setup fee. First month free.

name: P1 - Owner control
text:
Your home deserves the attention of a hotel revenue team.

Without giving up the keys.

That tension is the whole reason Stayzi exists. Large hotels have people whose entire job is watching demand and moving rates. A homeowner with one or two properties has evenings and weekends, and a full-time job that is not this.

So we do the work a revenue team would do, on your listing:

- Improve how the home is presented and how it ranks
- Review pricing against real demand, every week
- Answer guests, including at the hours you would rather not
- Handle the small daily problems before they become reviews

You keep the account. You keep the final say on rates, on rules, on who stays. Nothing moves out of your name.

You run the home. We get you the bookings.

name: P2 - Smarter pricing
text:
Your nightly rate should not be a guess.

And for most homes, that is exactly what it is.

A rate gets set when the listing goes live, usually by looking at two neighbours and splitting the difference. Then it sits there through a wedding season, a festival weekend, a monsoon lull and a December rush, as if those were all the same market.

They are not. Busy weekends, local events, seasonal demand and dead midweek dates each want a different answer.

On Stayzi Plus, rates are reviewed and adjusted every week. Not set once and forgotten.

The goal is not a bigger number on one night. It is a calendar that works harder across the whole quarter, without hosting becoming your second job.

name: P4 - Owner-first co-hosting
text:
Management should remove admin. Not ownership.

It is worth being precise about the difference, because plenty of arrangements blur it.

Stayzi works as a co-host on your existing Airbnb listing. You stay the owner of record. You keep full access to your own account, your payout details, and every review the home has earned.

What we take off your plate:

- Pricing and calendar management
- Listing performance
- Guest communication
- Dispute support

What we do not take: your listing, your account, your reviews, or your ability to walk away on a day's notice.

More support. No handover.

name: P5 - First step
text:
You should be able to find out whether better management suits your home before committing to anything.

So we made the first step cost nothing.

Your first month with Stayzi is free. No setup fee. No long-term contract. After that it is commission only, which means we get paid when Airbnb pays you and not before.

That arrangement is deliberate, and it cuts both ways. It is why we are selective about which homes we take on: if your place does not earn, neither do we.

If you own a home in Mumbai or Goa, a fifteen-minute call is enough for us to tell you what we think it would do.

name: P3 - Portfolio performance
text:
Real results, not vague promises.

Three homes we co-host, and the ratings their owners have earned:

Urban Beach House, a 2BHK in Juhu, Mumbai. 4.96 stars across 26 Airbnb reviews, and a Guest Favourite badge.

Paradise Home, Benaulim, Goa. 5.00 stars across 45 reviews.

Amber, Benaulim, Goa. 4.89 stars across 19 reviews.

Numbers like these come from consistent attention to the listing, the pricing, the guest communication and the experience on the ground. Not luck, and not one clever trick.

Worth being straight about what these are: the owners are the hosts of record and the reviews are theirs. We co-host. Every home is different, and past performance does not guarantee future results.

But every home deserves the same level of care.

Ratings as shown on Airbnb, 29 August 2026.
